stem: Which idea about change is developed in BOTH the article "A Country Connected" and the poem "The World Is at My Fingertips"?

options.label: A
options.text: People take time to adjust to big changes.

options.label: B
options.text: Change often comes when least expected.

options.label: C
options.text: Changes in the past affect how people live today.

options.label: D
options.text: New ideas can go through many different changes.

visual_elements: Multiple choice question with four options labeled A, B, C, and D.
